metadata.notes: Complete paired desktop fronts; corrected inward-facing chairs; one six-seat conference table; properly grouped kitchenette, refrigerator, water cooler and two-seat pantry tables on both floors. Removed misidentified devices and unfinished decor panels. All 20 workstations and room bounds preserved.
